name: conversion-cta
title: Conversion CTA
description: A closing product or marketing section with a concise headline, supporting copy, caller-supplied actions, and optional reassurance note. It provides left-aligned and centered compositions while leaving destination, analytics, loading, and error behavior to the consumer. Use it to make the next step clear after a page has established value; avoid adding multiple competing primary actions.

meta.engineeringNotes: Keeps the CTA's content and actions as slots instead of owning navigation or checkout state, so the same section composes with native links, app-router links, or application actions. CVA provides a small alignment matrix, while a single content container preserves the hierarchy between headline, explanation, actions, and reassurance.
meta.motionNotes: The section has no entrance or decorative animation; it should be available immediately when a visitor reaches the end of a page. Action controls remain ordinary consumer-supplied interactive elements with their own focus and feedback. Reduced-motion settings do not change the layout or hide content.

docs: Requires `cn` at `@/lib/utils`. Pass functional links or buttons through `actions`; the block does not select or infer a conversion destination.
